events.title: COVID-19 vaccines
events.description: Vaccines were developed, tested and approved in under a year, and the first doses were given in December 2020.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Vaccines were developed, tested and approved in under a year, and the first doses were given in December 2020.

events.title: SolarWinds hack
events.description: A compromised software update gave attackers access to US government agencies and thousands of organisations.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A compromised software update gave attackers access to US government agencies and thousands of organisations.

events.title: Long March 5B re-entries
events.description: Four 22-tonne Chinese rocket cores fell uncontrolled, landing near Ivory Coast, in the Indian Ocean, the Sulu Sea and the Pacific.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Four 22-tonne Chinese rocket cores fell uncontrolled, landing near Ivory Coast, in the Indian Ocean, the Sulu Sea and the Pacific.

events.title: Colonial Pipeline ransomware
events.description: A ransomware attack shut the largest fuel pipeline on the US east coast, causing panic buying.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A ransomware attack shut the largest fuel pipeline on the US east coast, causing panic buying.

events.title: Ingenuity on Mars
events.description: A small NASA helicopter made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A small NASA helicopter made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet.

events.title: Russian anti-satellite test
events.description: Debris from a destroyed satellite forced the ISS crew to shelter in their return vehicles.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Debris from a destroyed satellite forced the ISS crew to shelter in their return vehicles.

events.title: Don't Look Up
events.description: A satire about leaders ignoring a planet-killing comet, widely read as an allegory for climate inaction.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A satire about leaders ignoring a planet-killing comet, widely read as an allegory for climate inaction.

events.title: Zaporizhzhia
events.description: Europe's largest nuclear plant has been under Russian occupation since March 2022; by July 2026 it had lost all off-site power 22 times.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Europe's largest nuclear plant has been under Russian occupation since March 2022; by July 2026 it had lost all off-site power 22 times.

events.title: Russian nuclear threats
events.description: After invading Ukraine, Russia put its nuclear forces on special alert and repeatedly hinted at nuclear use.
events.descriptionMarkdown: After invading Ukraine, Russia put its nuclear forces on special alert and repeatedly hinted at nuclear use.

events.title: Hunga Tonga eruption
events.description: An undersea eruption near Tonga sent pressure waves around the world and cut the islands off from the internet.
events.descriptionMarkdown: An undersea eruption near Tonga sent pressure waves around the world and cut the islands off from the internet.

events.title: James Webb Space Telescope
events.description: The first images from the most powerful space telescope ever built showed galaxies in unprecedented detail.
events.descriptionMarkdown: The first images from the most powerful space telescope ever built showed galaxies in unprecedented detail.

events.title: DART
events.description: NASA deliberately crashed a spacecraft into the asteroid moonlet Dimorphos and measurably changed its orbit, a first test of planetary defence.
events.descriptionMarkdown: NASA deliberately crashed a spacecraft into the asteroid moonlet Dimorphos and measurably changed its orbit, a first test of planetary defence.

events.title: AI-designed chemical weapons
events.description: Researchers flipped a drug-discovery AI to reward toxicity, and it proposed 40,000 candidate chemical weapons in six hours.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Researchers flipped a drug-discovery AI to reward toxicity, and it proposed 40,000 candidate chemical weapons in six hours.

events.title: ChatGPT
events.description: OpenAI's chatbot reached about 100 million users within two months, setting off a wave of AI enthusiasm and investment.
events.descriptionMarkdown: OpenAI's chatbot reached about 100 million users within two months, setting off a wave of AI enthusiasm and investment.

events.title: Fusion ignition
events.description: The US National Ignition Facility produced more fusion energy than its lasers delivered, reviving hopes for fusion power.
events.descriptionMarkdown: The US National Ignition Facility produced more fusion energy than its lasers delivered, reviving hopes for fusion power.

events.title: Roblox and "brainrot"
events.description: Concern over children's exposure to harmful content on Roblox and to low-quality "brainrot" videos.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Concern over children's exposure to harmful content on Roblox and to low-quality "brainrot" videos.

events.title: AI extinction warnings
events.description: The FLI "pause" letter, Geoffrey Hinton quitting Google to speak out, the CAIS extinction statement and the first UN Security Council session on AI.
events.descriptionMarkdown: The FLI "pause" letter, Geoffrey Hinton quitting Google to speak out, the CAIS extinction statement and the first UN Security Council session on AI.

events.title: Bletchley Park AI Safety Summit
events.description: Governments including the US and China signed a declaration acknowledging potentially catastrophic risks from frontier AI.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Governments including the US and China signed a declaration acknowledging potentially catastrophic risks from frontier AI.

events.title: AI and jobs
events.description: Entry-level job offers in the US and UK fell by a third; in 2025 Ford's CEO predicted AI would replace half of US white-collar workers.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Entry-level job offers in the US and UK fell by a third; in 2025 Ford's CEO predicted AI would replace half of US white-collar workers.

events.title: Total solar eclipse
events.description: Millions travelled to see totality across Mexico, the US and Canada.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Millions travelled to see totality across Mexico, the US and Canada.

events.title: CrowdStrike outage
events.description: A faulty security update crashed 8.5 million Windows machines, halting airlines, banks and rail networks worldwide.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A faulty security update crashed 8.5 million Windows machines, halting airlines, banks and rail networks worldwide.

events.title: H5N1 in dairy cattle
events.description: Bird flu spread through US dairy herds and infected some farm workers, reviving pandemic fears.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Bird flu spread through US dairy herds and infected some farm workers, reviving pandemic fears.

events.title: AI Safety Clock
events.description: A business school launched a clock at 29 minutes to midnight to track AI risk; by September 2026 it stood at 15 minutes.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A business school launched a clock at 29 minutes to midnight to track AI risk; by September 2026 it stood at 15 minutes.

events.title: AI deception studies
events.description: Experiments showed frontier models sometimes scheming against oversight or faking alignment to avoid retraining.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Experiments showed frontier models sometimes scheming against oversight or faking alignment to avoid retraining.

events.title: Mirror life
events.description: 38 scientists warned in Science that mirror-image bacteria could evade immunity and disrupt ecosystems, and urged a halt.
events.descriptionMarkdown: 38 scientists warned in *Science* that mirror-image bacteria could evade immunity and disrupt ecosystems, and urged a halt.

events.title: Asteroid 2024 YR4
events.description: Impact odds for 2032 briefly reached about 3%, a record for an object its size, before falling to near zero.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Impact odds for 2032 briefly reached about 3%, a record for an object its size, before falling to near zero.

events.title: AI 2027
events.description: A detailed scenario by former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo and colleagues sketched superhuman AI arriving by 2027 and possibly escaping human control.
events.descriptionMarkdown: A detailed scenario by former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo and colleagues sketched superhuman AI arriving by 2027 and possibly escaping human control.

events.title: If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies
events.titleMarkdown: If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies
events.description: Yudkowsky and Soares's bestseller argued that superhuman AI built with current methods would kill everyone.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Yudkowsky and Soares's bestseller argued that superhuman AI built with current methods would kill everyone.

events.title: Superintelligence ban statement
events.description: Hundreds of public figures, including five Nobel laureates, called for a ban on developing superintelligence.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Hundreds of public figures, including five Nobel laureates, called for a ban on developing superintelligence.

events.title: Hantavirus panic
events.description: Fears that a hantavirus outbreak would become the next global pandemic.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Fears that a hantavirus outbreak would become the next global pandemic.

events.title: AI insiders' warnings
events.description: Sam Altman said the singularity had arrived; a departing Anthropic researcher called the next year or two "crunch time", and Anthropic's Evan Hubinger put the chance of AI killing all humans within a decade above 10%.
events.descriptionMarkdown: Sam Altman said the singularity had arrived; a departing Anthropic researcher called the next year or two "crunch time", and Anthropic's Evan Hubinger put the chance of AI killing all humans within a decade above 10%.
